content: Official MCP 2025-06-18/2025-11-25 authorization spec now mandates OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, RFC 8707 Resource Indicators (binding a token to one specific MCP server/audience) and strict audience validation specifically to prevent confused-deputy and token-passthrough attacks in MCP servers acting as proxies to third-party APIs; MCP servers with 'ambient authority' (one token usable for everything) are the named anti-pattern — every tool call should be scoped to the authenticated caller's own data.
